segments: "KEITH REYNOLDS" in bold white text fades in on a black screen, then quickly fades out
A small blue sedan drives right on the black horizon towards a tall solid black building. The sky is bright with a couple clouds
"Keith Reynolds can't make it tonight" in bold white text on a black background appears
Closer view of the blue sedan in front of the building. Keith Reynolds, a blue stick figure, steps out of the car and starts walking
Upbeat music starts as the figure walks up the stairs. A narrator says "This is Keith Reynolds, and today is promotion day"
The elevator moves up to the 4th floor. Narrator: "when he gets his promotion he'll finally be a successful businessman"
Keith hands Sarah the cup of coffee before walking away. Narrator continues: "She never wants one"
Camera pans to the second floor. Narrator: "Meanwhile, on the second floor,"
Camera pans back to Keith riding the elevator up. Narrator: "Keith Reynold's reflection is looking confidently back at him from the shiny surface of the inside of the elevator"
Patrick Campbell rides the elevator down. Narrator: "Patrick Campbell is slicking back his hair and straightening his tie.
Camera pans back up to Keith shaking hands with his boss. Narrator: "The handshake was weaker than expected"
Camera pans back to the 4th floor, where Patrick is talking to Sarah. Narrator: "That's him telling his good news to Sarah now on the 4th floor"
The doors of the elevator open. Keith drops his suitcase when he sees Sarah embracing Patrick. Narrator: "They were kissing"

Patrick starts walking to the elevator. Narrator: "Keith Reynold's fantasy of what he would do to Patrick Campbell if he were trapped in a small room with him is interrupted by the same Patrick Campbell asking him to hold the elevator door. He felt himself take a deep breath"
Patrick exits the elevator. Narrator: "He exhales a deep breath and as he does 3 words slip out"
Patrick punches Keith, knocking off his hat. Keith headbutts Patrick in retaliation, drawing blood. Narrator: "some quick thinking was needed"

Ruth closes a file cabinet and walks to the stairs. Narrator: "Ruth Charles from accounts needs the toilet. Her favorite one in the building is on the 7th floor, because it has a nicer soap dispenser"
Camera pans back up to Keith, who's dealing with Patrick. Narrator: "Keith Reynolds has decided to take Patrick home until he has time to dispose of him properly"
Camera pans back to Ruth, who is walking up the stairs. Narrator: "Ruth Charles has reached the 6th floor and is also thinking about going home"
Camera pans down to Sarah's floor. Narrator: "It already feels like hours since Sarah last saw Patrick, so she's decided to take some files up to his office, as an excuse to see him again"

Camera pans back to Keith, who is dragging Patrick's body. Narrator: "After a quick rethink, Keith Reynolds has decided to climb down the rather convenient ladder he has spotted outside the 5th floor window. That way he doesn't have to worry about passing security on his way to the ground floor"
Camera pans to the ground floor for a moment, where employees are throwing crumpled paper balls
Camera pans back up to Keith and Sarah's floor. Sarah drops her folder after seeing Keith dragging Patrick's body Narrator: "Sarah sees Keith"
Sarah faints and falls to the ground. Keith looks down dejectedly. Narrator: "She fainted. He guessed dead bodies had that effect on women"
Keith drags Patrick's body out of the window. Narrator: "and as Keith tugged Patrick out onto the ladder, he suddenly realizes..."
Keith looks up. Narrator: "He takes one last look at the building that has been his life for the last 8 years and sees a man he's never seen before"
